title: ‘A Breaking Point’: The Minneapolis Police Chief on ICE

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Just hours before a federal immigration officer killed Renee Good in her car, the Minneapolis police chief warned that a tragedy involving ICE
sentences.zh: 就在一名联邦移民官员在车内杀害蕾妮·古德的几小时前，明尼阿波利斯警察局长曾警告说，一场涉及美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）的悲剧

sentences.en: and the people of his city seemed inevitable.
sentences.zh: 和他所在城市的人民之间似乎不可避免。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with that police chief, Brian O'Hara, about his experience with ICE in Minneapolis and why, in his mind, the president's campaign of mass deportation
sentences.zh: 今天，我将与那位警察局长布莱恩·奥哈拉谈谈他在明尼阿波利斯与ICE打交道的经历，以及为什么在他看来，总统的大规模驱逐行动

sentences.en: is undermining faith in police departments like his.
sentences.zh: 正在破坏人们对他这类警察部门的信任。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月12日，星期一。

sentences.en: Chief O'Hara, thank you for making time for us on a Sunday, no less, and a very busy weekend for you.
sentences.zh: 奥哈拉局长，感谢您在周日抽出时间接受我们的采访，这对您来说一定是个非常忙碌的周末。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: The past 48 hours were pretty extraordinary from the perspective of an outsider.
sentences.zh: 从局外人的角度来看，过去48小时相当不寻常。

sentences.en: There were these enormous protests.
sentences.zh: 发生了大规模的抗议活动。

sentences.en: I believe you yourself ended up in the middle of one of them.
sentences.zh: 我相信您本人最终也身处其中一场抗议活动的中心。

sentences.en: I've tried to make sense of the video.
sentences.zh: 我试着去理解视频里的内容。

sentences.en: I mean, what has this been like for you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这对您来说是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: So what happened was we had a protest start outside of a hotel where people believed federal law enforcement might be staying.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，我们有一场抗议活动始于一家酒店外，人们认为联邦执法人员可能住在那里。

sentences.en: They believed ICE agents were staying there, right?
sentences.zh: 他们认为ICE特工住在那里，对吧？

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: During the course of that protest in March, it sort of transitioned into an unlawful assembly.
sentences.zh: 在三月份那场抗议过程中，它演变成了一种非法集会。

sentences.en: And things that typically happen in cities happen, and a woman who was disoriented drove her car onto a sidewalk, and the police were called to respond.
sentences.zh: 城市里通常会发生的事情发生了，一名神志不清的妇女把车开上了人行道，警察被叫去处理。

sentences.en: So while the police car was there dealing with regular police work,
sentences.zh: 所以当警车在那里处理常规警务工作时，

sentences.en: suddenly they realized they had become surrounded by this crowd, which had become unruly.
sentences.zh: 他们突然意识到自己被这群变得难以控制的人群包围了。

sentences.en: So our officers called in that they were unable to drive out, and I was in the area personally with other police officers.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的警员呼叫说他们无法开车离开，而我当时正和其他警察在附近。

sentences.en: We quickly ran in to back the crowd out to get a path for the police car to come out.
sentences.zh: 我们迅速跑过去驱散人群，为警车开辟出一条通道。

sentences.en: And I think because we did that, I think that may have contributed to emboldening an already unruly crowd, and we very quickly called in well over 200 additional police officers.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是因为我们这样做，可能助长了那群本就难以控制的人群的气焰，我们很快就增派了200多名警察。

sentences.en: And then ultimately, we wound up placing 30 people under arrest for unlawful assembly and releasing them.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们以非法集会为由逮捕了30人，随后将他们释放。

sentences.en: It's been very taxing for all members of the police department, and this is a situation that has been building up for several weeks.
sentences.zh: 这对警察局的所有成员来说都非常吃力，这种情况已经酝酿了好几个星期。

sentences.en: A lot of the disturbances and chaos that's been happening here as a result of the manner in which some federal enforcement activity is happening
sentences.zh: 这里发生的许多骚乱和混乱，都是由于一些联邦执法活动的方式所导致的，

sentences.en: is requiring our officers to respond and step into situations and try and restore the peace, where oftentimes they themselves then become the target of people's frustration.
sentences.zh: 这要求我们的警员必须介入并试图恢复和平，而往往他们自己随后就成了人们发泄不满的目标。

sentences.en: Well, you're hinting at all this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，您提到了这一切。

sentences.en: The reason we're talking to you, of course, is because of the fact that ICE is there, but because specifically of what an ICE agent did in the middle of last week,
sentences.zh: 我们采访您的原因，当然是因为ICE在那里，但具体是因为上周中期一名ICE特工所做的事情，

sentences.en: the shooting of a Minneapolis resident, Renee Good, a shooting that killed Ms. Good.
sentences.zh: 即枪杀明尼阿波利斯居民蕾妮·古德，这场枪击导致古德女士死亡。

sentences.en: And at this point, millions of people have watched the video of that shooting from every conceivable angle on social media, on TV news,
sentences.zh: 目前，数以百万计的人已经在社交媒体和电视新闻上从各个可能的角度观看了那场枪击事件的视频，

sentences.en: but there was a lead-up to that shooting that a lot of us didn't watch as closely and didn't see on TV or on YouTube, and that was the arrival of a large number of immigration
sentences.zh: 但那场枪击事件之前还有一段前奏，我们很多人并没有密切关注，也没有在电视或YouTube上看到，那就是从12月初开始，大量移民

sentences.en: and customs enforcement agents starting in early December.
sentences.zh: 和海关执法局特工的到来。

sentences.en: And so that's where I want to begin.
sentences.zh: 所以我想从这里开始。

sentences.en: Take me back to that period for you as police chief.
sentences.zh: 带我回到您作为警察局长的那段时期。

sentences.en: What was your understanding of why the president decided to send these agents to your city?
sentences.zh: 您对总统决定派遣这些特工到您城市的初衷有何理解？

sentences.en: About a month ago in December, it seemed like the public messaging was largely political, and it was a result of a real problem that does exist in the state,
sentences.zh: 大约一个月前，即12月，公共信息似乎主要是出于政治目的，这是该州确实存在的一个真正问题的结果，

sentences.en: and that is a problem with fraud.
sentences.zh: 那就是欺诈问题。

sentences.en: Dozens of people have been prosecuted by the FBI and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 数十人已被联邦调查局（FBI）和美国

sentences.en: Attorney's Office here in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官办公室在明尼苏达州起诉。

sentences.en: You're referring to the fraud that had been specifically highlighted in the Somali community in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 您指的是明尼阿波利斯索马里社区中特别突出的欺诈行为。

sentences.en: And I do want to talk about the president's message when he decided to send specifically immigration officers to Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 我确实想谈谈总统决定派遣移民官员到明尼阿波利斯时的信息。

sentences.en: I mean, he was pretty explicit about his thinking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他对自己想法的表达非常明确。

sentences.en: In his mind, the Somali population in the city, which is sizable and well-known, he described it as a community that was sowing disorder, committing crimes.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，该市规模庞大且广为人知的索马里群体，被他描述为一个制造混乱、犯罪的社区。

sentences.en: Basically, in so many words, a community of troublemakers who should be deported.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，用他的话说，这是一个应该被驱逐的麻烦制造者社区。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you made of that and if it felt like that had been your experience as chief.
sentences.zh: 我想知道您对此有何看法，以及这是否符合您作为局长的经历。

sentences.en: Well, I'm from about 10 miles from lower Manhattan is where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 我是在距离曼哈顿下城约10英里远的地方长大的。

sentences.en: I was a police officer for over 20 years in Newark, New Jersey, but I had not known any Somali-Americans until I moved to Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 我在新泽西州纽瓦克当了20多年的警察，但在搬到明尼苏达州之前，我不认识任何索马里裔美国人。

sentences.en: And the Somali-Americans that I have met here, including many of whom are police officers in this city, have been incredibly welcoming of me.
sentences.zh: 而我在这里遇到的索马里裔美国人，包括许多在这个城市当警察的人，对我非常热情。

sentences.en: So from a personal perspective, it was just bizarre because I'm also aware that the overwhelming majority of people from that community are American citizens.
sentences.zh: 所以从个人角度来看，这太奇怪了，因为我也知道该社区绝大多数人都是美国公民。

sentences.en: Well, from a crime perspective, was anything the president was saying true?
sentences.zh: 那么，从犯罪的角度来看，总统所说的一切属实吗？

sentences.en: Well, there is a real problem with fraud in the state.
sentences.zh: 该州确实存在严重的欺诈问题。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, that is sort of lost now in all of this political rhetoric and sort of the extreme reactions that occur.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在所有这些政治言论和随之而来的极端反应中，这一点似乎被忽略了。

sentences.en: You're drawing a distinction between fraud and kind of traditional street crime.
sentences.zh: 您在欺诈和传统的街头犯罪之间划清了界限。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，是的，是的。

sentences.en: But you're acknowledging that there's some level of fraud occurring perhaps in this community.
sentences.zh: 但您承认在这个社区中可能存在一定程度的欺诈行为。

sentences.en: Perhaps that's what the president is referring to.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是总统所指的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In your mind, that's distinct from perhaps the crime that you and your officers are dealing with day in and day out.
sentences.zh: 在您看来，这与您和您的警员每天处理的犯罪行为是不同的。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对不同。

sentences.en: Those cases that were brought about leading to dozens and dozens of prosecutions were led by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那些导致数十起起诉的案件是由美国

sentences.en: Attorney's Office here in Minnesota as well as the FBI.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州联邦检察官办公室以及联邦调查局牵头的。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So in your mind, was this planned deployment, specifically of ICE agents that the president asked for, was it warranted?
sentences.zh: 那么在您看来，这种有计划的部署，特别是总统要求的ICE特工部署，是有正当理由的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, there have been immigration enforcement conducted in Minnesota as long as there has been ICE.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，只要有ICE存在，明尼苏达州就一直有移民执法行动。

sentences.en: I think the problem is what gets lost in this is it's not necessarily about which laws are being enforced.
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于，人们忽略了重点，这不一定关乎执行什么法律。

sentences.en: It's about how that enforcement is happening.
sentences.zh: 而是关乎执法的方式。

sentences.en: To the extent that there are well-planned, pre-planned, targeted enforcement against people who are violating the law,
sentences.zh: 如果是有计划、预先策划、针对违法者的执法行动，

sentences.en: I think all of law enforcement can very clearly get behind that.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有执法部门都能明确支持。

sentences.en: But to the extent that things are being conducted that may not be well-planned, using tactics that generally are not viewed as sound,
sentences.zh: 但如果行动缺乏周密计划，使用了通常被认为不妥当的战术，

sentences.en: that may unnecessarily endanger the lives both of law enforcement officers conducting that enforcement as well as the lives of people in the community.
sentences.zh: 那可能会不必要地危及执法人员和社区民众的生命安全。

sentences.en: Certainly, those are concerns that I have to deal with, and I am responsible for as a professional managing my agency.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些是我必须处理的问题，作为一名专业管理机构的负责人，我有责任解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it sounds like for you, it's not the fact of ICE coming that is the issue.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来对您来说，问题不在于ICE的到来。

sentences.en: It's the way that ICE came.
sentences.zh: 而在于ICE到来的方式。

sentences.en: So let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: So the president makes his case that immigration enforcement should be happening on a larger scale in Minneapolis, and in early December, he makes it happen.
sentences.zh: 总统提出移民执法应该在明尼阿波利斯更大规模地进行，并在12月初付诸实施。

sentences.en: How did the operations of these ICE agents work, and how did it start to affect the police department that you run?
sentences.zh: 这些ICE特工的行动是如何运作的，又是如何开始影响您管理的警察部门的？

sentences.en: What changed?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: I mean, you're hinting that their tactics are different.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，您暗示他们的战术与众不同。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we've just gotten a pretty dramatic increase in 911 calls from people in the community related to a lot of the street enforcement that's happening.
sentences.zh: 我们接到的911报警电话急剧增加，这些电话都与正在发生的许多街头执法行动有关。

sentences.en: And I mean, it's everything from people are being arrested, and their cars are left in the roadway, sometimes blocking the street,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，各种情况都有，人们被捕，车子被留在路上，有时堵塞交通，

sentences.en: and at one case, left when it wasn't even placed in park and was rolling down the road.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一次，车子没挂P档就停在那，顺着路滑走了。

sentences.en: Wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等。

sentences.en: So ICE officials are taking someone out of their car, arresting them, and their car is not even put in park?
sentences.zh: 所以ICE官员把人从车里带走，逮捕他们，而车子甚至没挂P档？

sentences.en: We had that happen.
sentences.zh: 我们确实遇到过这种情况。

sentences.en: We had another time where there was a dog in the car, and they left the dog in the car.
sentences.zh: 还有一次车里有条狗，他们就把狗留在车里了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I mean, even this morning, we've gotten calls for individuals who were pepper-sprayed by ICE.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就在今天早上，我们还接到电话，有人被ICE喷了胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: There's just a variety of calls for service that we then have to manage and triage that were not happening before.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的服务需求电话都需要我们去管理和分流，而这些在以前是不会发生的。

sentences.en: And how does that sudden influx of 911 calls, because people are experiencing ICE tactics, affect the department as a whole?
sentences.zh: 那么，由于人们正在经历ICE的战术，这种911报警电话的突然激增，对整个部门有什么影响？

sentences.en: How does it complicate your policing?
sentences.zh: 这如何让您的警务工作变得复杂？

sentences.en: It complicates things because we remain significantly understaffed.
sentences.zh: 这让事情变得复杂，因为我们依然严重人手不足。

sentences.en: This is the Minneapolis Police Department.
sentences.zh: 这是明尼阿波利斯警察局。

sentences.en: The majority of the cops that worked here in 2020, five years later, the majority have left.
sentences.zh: 2020年在这里工作的大多数警察，五年后，大部分都已经离开了。

sentences.en: And we're trying to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力重建。

sentences.en: We remain one-third below what had been typical of staffing for the police department here today,
sentences.zh: 我们今天的警力仍然比警察局往常的水平低三分之一，

sentences.en: while we're dealing with a much higher level of serious street crime than what had been normal in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 而我们面对的严重街头犯罪水平却比过去正常时期要高得多。

sentences.en: So this is adding additional work.
sentences.zh: 所以这增加了额外的工作量。

sentences.en: Probably the toughest distinction is we're getting called and pulled into situations that are very tense and very emotionally charged.
sentences.zh: 最难区分的可能是，我们被叫去处理那些非常紧张且情绪激动的局面。

sentences.en: And oftentimes we're asked to try and step in and de-escalate situations where federal law enforcement may have been involved.
sentences.zh: 而且我们经常被要求介入并缓和那些可能有联邦执法部门参与的情况。

sentences.en: That very, very quickly, as soon as we show up, we become the target of people's frustration.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们出现，我们很快就会成为人们发泄不满的目标。

sentences.en: So the minute you show up...
sentences.zh: 所以就在你们出现的那一刻……

sentences.en: The minute we show up, we're the problem.
sentences.zh: 我们出现的那一刻，我们就是问题所在。

sentences.en: You know, people are ready to go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们已经准备好爆发了。

sentences.en: It could very, very quickly explode.
sentences.zh: 情况可能会非常快地失控。

sentences.en: And with the level of staffing that we have, and the time that it takes to get the National Guard to come in, it will be too late.
sentences.zh: 以我们现有的警力，加上等待国民警卫队赶来的时间，一切都太晚了。

sentences.en: That's my fear.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的担忧。

sentences.en: I mean, you've been talking around this, and I think we should just make this extremely explicit,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，您一直在绕着这个问题谈，我认为我们应该把话说得非常直白，

sentences.en: that you come to the job of being police chief in Minneapolis at a very specific moment with a very specific mandate.
sentences.zh: 您是在一个非常特殊的时刻，带着非常明确的任务来到明尼阿波利斯担任警察局长的。

sentences.en: You arrive just two years after a Minneapolis police officer murdered George Floyd,
sentences.zh: 您在一名明尼阿波利斯警察谋杀乔治·弗洛伊德两年后上任，

sentences.en: at a moment of extremely low morale for the department and really high levels of distrust of the police department by the community.
sentences.zh: 当时部门士气极低，社区对警察部门的不信任感极高。

sentences.en: And when you took this job, I went back and looked at the old clips.
sentences.zh: 当您接受这份工作时，我回去看了看旧的新闻片段。

sentences.en: You called Minneapolis ground zero for a global reckoning on policing.
sentences.zh: 您称明尼阿波利斯是全球警务清算的“零地带”。

sentences.en: And you, in the job, put in place sweeping reforms to try to rebuild trust, repair relationships between police and residents.
sentences.zh: 而且您在任职期间，实施了全面的改革，试图重建信任，修复警察与居民之间的关系。

sentences.en: Just give us a couple examples of the reforms you put in place and that presumably are now being somewhat challenged by ISIS presence.
sentences.zh: 请给我们举几个您实施的改革例子，这些改革现在想必正受到ICE存在的某种挑战。

sentences.en: So we have placed a very strong emphasis on use of force, on employing de-escalation, on the use of critical decision-making practices.
sentences.zh: 我们非常强调武力使用、缓和冲突以及关键决策实践的运用。

sentences.en: We have gone out and had dozens of community meetings to get input from community as we revise our policies.
sentences.zh: 我们走出去召开了数十次社区会议，在修订政策时听取社区的意见。

sentences.en: And I think it all boils down to trying to fight crime in a way that earns community trust, as opposed to alienating people.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切归根结底是为了以一种赢得社区信任的方式打击犯罪，而不是疏远民众。

sentences.en: And from what you're saying, suddenly, as of a few weeks ago, all of that work is confronted with an outside group of federal law enforcement officials
sentences.zh: 而根据您所说的，突然间，从几周前开始，所有这些工作都面临着一群外部联邦执法官员的挑战，

sentences.en: arriving in your city, doing police work, but who don't answer to you and are not as inevitably invested in the reform efforts that you have put in place.
sentences.zh: 他们来到您的城市，从事警务工作，但他们不对您负责，也不像您那样必然投入到您所实施的改革努力中。

sentences.en: They have a totally different mandate.
sentences.zh: 他们有完全不同的任务。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you're saying all of a sudden that is just immediately overshadowing, challenging, complicating this entire project that you have overtaken as police chief.
sentences.zh: 听起来您是说，突然之间，这立刻掩盖、挑战并复杂化了您作为警察局长所接手的整个项目。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And in the midst of all of those challenges, while we're trying to heal this community,
sentences.zh: 在所有这些挑战中，当我们试图治愈这个社区时，

sentences.en: while we're trying to heal the men and women who have remained here and rebuild while they're already the most scrutinized police department in the nation.
sentences.zh: 当我们试图治愈那些留在这里的人们并进行重建时，他们已经是全国受到最严密审查的警察部门了。

sentences.en: And I can tell you, like, the cops here, we're human beings.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉您，这里的警察也是人。

sentences.en: And I worry that we might hit a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 我担心我们可能会达到崩溃的临界点。

sentences.en: It feels like as the weeks went on here, that residents are taking it upon themselves to monitor ICE agents and their activity.
sentences.zh: 感觉随着几周过去，居民们开始自发地监督ICE特工及其活动。

sentences.en: Minneapolis, this is not a secret, pretty liberal city.
sentences.zh: 明尼阿波利斯，这不是什么秘密，是一个相当自由派的城市。

sentences.en: And there are residents who organize themselves in this period into groups.
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，有居民自发组织成小组。

sentences.en: They're shadowing ICE agents.
sentences.zh: 他们正在跟踪ICE特工。

sentences.en: They're texting each other.
sentences.zh: 他们正在互相发短信。

sentences.en: They're blowing whistles.
sentences.zh: 他们正在吹哨子。

sentences.en: And it's amounting to a pretty meaningful effort to counter their enforcement operations.
sentences.zh: 这正在形成一股相当有力的反制行动，来对抗他们的执法作业。

sentences.en: I don't know if you quibble with that word.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否会对这个词有异议。

sentences.en: Does that become its own problem?
sentences.zh: 这会演变成它自身的问题吗？

sentences.en: And did you find yourself wishing that the residents were not doing that?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾希望居民们不要那样做？

sentences.en: Did you try to discourage it?
sentences.zh: 你有没有尝试去劝阻？

sentences.en: Well, I can tell you the role of the police and law enforcement in the United States is first off to protect life,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可以告诉你，美国警察和执法部门的首要职责是保护生命，

sentences.en: but it's also to ensure people's human rights and their constitutional rights.
sentences.zh: 但同时也要确保人们的人权和宪法权利。

sentences.en: And people in this country have a First Amendment right to observe, record, and object to government activity.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的人民拥有第一修正案赋予的权利，可以观察、记录并反对政府行为。

sentences.en: And that includes the activity that Minneapolis police officers do, as well as other law enforcement in our city.
sentences.zh: 这包括明尼阿波利斯警官的行为，也包括我们市其他执法部门的行为。

sentences.en: And so it is a challenge, but it's a challenge that policing in America has been dealing with and trying to improve upon for many years.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是个挑战，但这是美国警务工作多年来一直在应对并努力改进的挑战。

sentences.en: It does add a level of complication to our work.
sentences.zh: 这确实给我们的工作增加了一定程度的复杂性。

sentences.en: But I just want to be clear, though.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想说明白一点。

sentences.en: I'm not asking for federal law enforcement to do anything differently than what I expect the men and women of the Minneapolis Police Department to do.
sentences.zh: 我并不是要求联邦执法部门做任何与我对明尼阿波利斯警察局男女警员所期望的不同之事。

sentences.en: What you're describing clearly sounds like a pretty combustible combination.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的情况听起来显然是一个相当易燃的组合。

sentences.en: You've got ICE agents who are operating with their own systems and set of rules, and then you have these residents, in your words, operating their First Amendment right,
sentences.zh: 你有按照自己系统和规则行事的移民及海关执法局（ICE）特工，然后又有你所说的行使第一修正案权利的居民，

sentences.en: to surround them, to monitor them, to scream at them.
sentences.zh: 去包围他们、监视他们、对他们大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And this is adding up to clearly a very delicate situation.
sentences.zh: 这一切加起来显然是一个非常微妙的局面。

sentences.en: And there's a moment that I want to ask you about, because it felt oddly prescient, where within the last week or so, you stand up at a news conference, and you say, basically,
sentences.zh: 有一个时刻我想问问你，因为它感觉出奇地有预见性，就在过去一周左右，你在新闻发布会上站出来，基本上说，

sentences.en: I am worried.
sentences.zh: 我很担心。

sentences.en: I do have an ask.
sentences.zh: 我有一个请求。

sentences.en: That's both for federal law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这是针对联邦执法部门的。

sentences.en: You say, ICE agents, you have your job to do, but please do it lawfully.
sentences.zh: 你说，ICE特工，你们有你们的工作要做，但请依法行事。

sentences.en: And at the same time, to members of the community.
sentences.zh: 同时，也是对社区成员说的。

sentences.en: Residents, yes, you can have your proteSt.
sentences.zh: 居民们，是的，你们可以抗议。

sentences.en: Please do it peacefully.
sentences.zh: 但请和平地进行。

sentences.en: I've been concerned for weeks that because the issue is so emotional, and because, frankly, some of the way this stuff has been carried out,
sentences.zh: 几周来我一直很担心，因为这个问题太情绪化了，而且坦率地说，这种事情的执行方式，

sentences.en: the greatest risk to me is that there would be unrest or that there would be a tragedy, that somebody could get seriously hurt or killed.
sentences.zh: 对我来说最大的风险是会出现动乱或悲剧，有人可能会受重伤或丧命。

sentences.en: But you seem to kind of know that something awful was coming.
sentences.zh: 但你似乎预感到会有可怕的事情发生。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, this was predictable.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是可以预见的。

sentences.en: And it's also entirely preventable.
sentences.zh: 而且这完全是可以预防的。

sentences.en: I mean, I had been saying it for weeks.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我几周来一直在说。

sentences.en: I literally said it at a press conference the day before.
sentences.zh: 前一天在新闻发布会上我甚至亲口说了。

sentences.en: And when you found out that it was true, that there was a shooting involving an ICE agent, what was your first thought?
sentences.zh: 当你发现这是真的，确实发生了涉及ICE特工的枪击事件时，你的第一个念头是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm having a hard time describing it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我很难描述那种感觉。

sentences.en: I just thought, fuck, this is it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，该死，这就是了。

sentences.en: You know, this is the potential here for 2020 all over again.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这有可能让2020年的情况重演。

sentences.en: For George Floyd all over again.
sentences.zh: 让乔治·弗洛伊德事件重演。

sentences.en: For the destruction of the city.
sentences.zh: 让这座城市再次遭到破坏。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Mazursky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, I understand that an investigation is still underway of what happened in this shooting.
sentences.zh: 那么，我了解到针对这次枪击事件的调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: And we don't know exactly what that investigation is going to look like or what it's going to conclude.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道调查的具体情况或最终结论是什么。

sentences.en: And we'll talk in just a few moments about the conflict arising from the investigation over whose investigation it should be.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会谈谈调查中关于“应该由谁来调查”这一冲突。

sentences.en: But just to focus for a minute on the shooting itself, have you watched the videos?
sentences.zh: 但先专注于枪击事件本身，你看过视频了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I've seen the videos that are available online.
sentences.zh: 是的，我看过网上流传的视频。

sentences.en: What is your understanding?
sentences.zh: 你的了解是什么？

sentences.en: My understanding is that there was a woman who was in her car and was blocking the street, likely because immigration agents were present.
sentences.zh: 我的了解是，有一名女子在车里堵住了街道，很可能是因为移民局特工在场。

sentences.en: And she was likely protesting in some way, immigration officials being present.
sentences.zh: 她很可能是在以某种方式抗议移民局官员的在场。

sentences.en: And ultimately, some confrontation occurred where federal law enforcement shot into the vehicle, killing her.
sentences.zh: 最终，发生了一些冲突，联邦执法人员向车内开枪，导致她死亡。

sentences.en: Having watched the videos and spoken perhaps to responding officers, does this strike you as a lawful interaction between the ICE officer and the resident?
sentences.zh: 在看过视频并可能与出警警官交谈后，你认为这是ICE警官与居民之间合法的互动吗？

sentences.en: Well, I can tell you as a police officer for 25 years, anytime you hear a situation where a cop gets into shooting with an unarmed motorist, it gives you pause.
sentences.zh: 嗯，作为一名有25年经验的警察，每当你听到警察与手无寸铁的司机发生枪击事件时，你都会感到迟疑。

sentences.en: And it's very concerning because while policies and training try to do everything possible to prohibit those situations and to try and prevent them from occurring in the first place,
sentences.zh: 这非常令人担忧，因为尽管政策和培训尽一切可能禁止此类情况并试图从源头上预防它们，

sentences.en: there are times, unfortunately, where law enforcement cannot avoid those situations from occurring.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，有时执法部门无法避免这些情况的发生。

sentences.en: The concern is, as a professional,
sentences.zh: 作为专业人士，我们的担忧在于，

sentences.en: to try and prevent our people from getting into that situation in the first place so that we're not unnecessarily creating the risk unjustifiably.
sentences.zh: 尽量防止我们的人员首先陷入那种境地，这样我们就不会无谓地、不合理地制造风险。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: You mentioned training.
sentences.zh: 你提到了培训。

sentences.en: My sense is that there are some pretty universal rules around policing when it comes to a motorist in a running car.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，在警务工作中，对于行驶中的车辆里的司机，有一些相当普遍的规则。

sentences.en: The number one is, you don't place yourself in the path of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 第一条是，不要让自己处于车辆的行驶路径上。

sentences.en: That's like traffic stop 101.
sentences.zh: 这就像交通拦截的基本常识。

sentences.en: You don't do that.
sentences.zh: 你不能那样做。

sentences.en: So in your mind, that's a flag, that you have this ICE agent, the one who ends up shooting Renee Good, standing in front of her car.
sentences.zh: 所以在你看来，这是一个危险信号，即这位ICE特工，也就是最终射杀Renee Good的那位，站在了她的车前。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And then the other one is, what exactly is the mission here?
sentences.zh: 那么另一个问题是，这里的任务到底是什么？

sentences.en: Because if this person isn't the target of a pre-planned enforcement action, then what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 因为如果此人不是预先计划的执法行动的目标，那我们在做什么？

sentences.en: Are we trying to de-escalate and try and resolve the situation?
sentences.zh: 我们是在试图缓和局势并解决问题吗？

sentences.en: Are we trying to take an enforcement action and enforce some law here?
sentences.zh: 我们是在试图采取执法行动并执行某项法律吗？

sentences.en: Or what exactly is the goal?
sentences.zh: 或者目标到底是什么？

sentences.en: We're focusing here on the ICE officers.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里关注的是ICE特工。

sentences.en: I do want to ask you about the driver's decision-making in this moment.
sentences.zh: 我确实想问你关于司机在那个时刻的决策。

sentences.en: Her refusal to get out of the car, even after ICE agents demand that she get out of the car.
sentences.zh: 即使在ICE特工要求她下车后，她仍拒绝下车。

sentences.en: Her reversing, then driving forward.
sentences.zh: 她倒车，然后向前行驶。

sentences.en: She appears to disobey spoken orders from these officers.
sentences.zh: 她似乎不服从这些警官的口头命令。

sentences.en: As somebody who thinks about this stuff, let's just ask this really plainly.
sentences.zh: 作为一个思考这些问题的人，我们直截了当地问吧。

sentences.en: Was she in the wrong?
sentences.zh: 她错了吗？

sentences.en: Well, I can only speak to conducting the traffic stop from my perspective as a police officer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只能从我作为一名警察的角度来谈如何进行交通拦截。

sentences.en: What is our policy?
sentences.zh: 我们的政策是什么？

sentences.en: What is our training?
sentences.zh: 我们的培训是什么？

sentences.en: Number one, you approach the driver.
sentences.zh: 第一，你要接近司机。

sentences.en: You introduce yourself by rank, by name, by what agency you work for.
sentences.zh: 你要报上你的职衔、姓名以及你所属的机构。

sentences.en: And you tell the person, explain why the person is being stopped.
sentences.zh: 你要告诉对方，解释为什么要拦截此人。

sentences.en: You do these sorts of things to try and ensure, number one, to identify yourself, but to try and ensure a level of professionalism and to try and de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 你做这些事情是为了确保，第一，表明身份，同时也是为了确保专业水平并尝试缓和局势。

sentences.en: If the person asks you a question that's reasonable, you respond to it reasonably.
sentences.zh: 如果对方问了一个合理的问题，你要合理地回答。

sentences.en: That is the expectation.
sentences.zh: 这就是期望。

sentences.en: And did the ICE agent do any of that?
sentences.zh: 那么ICE特工做了这些吗？

sentences.en: My recollection is that there was not.
sentences.zh: 我的记忆中是没有。

sentences.en: And further, it just seems like there's confusion.
sentences.zh: 而且进一步说，似乎存在混乱。

sentences.en: And I don't know, just from what I recall, but it seems like someone else is saying to get out of the car than the officer who shot.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，仅凭我的记忆，似乎是除了开枪的警官之外的另一个人在喊下车。

sentences.en: And it's not clear to me whether the two of them were working together and understood what each other was trying to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 我不清楚他们两人是否在协同工作，并且理解对方想要达成什么目标。

sentences.en: Do you feel that this would have ended differently had this been handled entirely by the MPD, not ICE?
sentences.zh: 你认为如果这件事完全由明尼阿波利斯警察局（MPD）处理，而不是由ICE处理，结果会不同吗？

sentences.en: No question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Do you have any empathy for the ICE officer, given the split-second nature of policing, putting aside whether he should have ever been in front of the car?
sentences.zh: 考虑到警务工作的瞬息万变，撇开他是否应该站在车前不谈，你对那位ICE警官有同情心吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对有。

sentences.en: Law enforcement leaders, executives, have an obligation to their people.
sentences.zh: 执法部门的领导和高管对他们的人员负有义务。

sentences.en: We have an obligation to ensure that our people have sufficient policies, sufficient training, sufficient experiences for the challenges that we are placing them into.
sentences.zh: 我们有义务确保我们的人员拥有足够的政策、足够的培训、足够的经验来应对我们让他们面临的挑战。

sentences.en: We have an obligation not to send our people out there and to tell them, you know, you have a specific quota today.
sentences.zh: 我们有义务不把我们的人员派出去，然后告诉他们，你知道，你今天有特定的配额。

sentences.en: You have to get a certain number of people.
sentences.zh: 你必须抓到一定数量的人。

sentences.en: I mean, it seems like that's the situation these folks are being placed into.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人似乎正处于这种境地。

sentences.en: And that went out the window a long time ago in professional policing.
sentences.zh: 而在专业警务工作中，那种做法早就被淘汰了。

sentences.en: And considering this agent was seriously injured in a stop, you know, somewhat recently, it certainly raises questions as to what did the agency do to protect their person?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这位特工不久前在一次拦截中受了重伤，这确实引发了关于该机构采取了什么措施来保护其人员的问题。

sentences.en: You're referring to the fact that I believe this officer in the Times has written about it was involved in a stop where he was dragged in a car.
sentences.zh: 你指的是我相信《泰晤士报》报道的那位警官，他曾参与一次拦截，结果被拖在车里。

sentences.en: Yes, he sustained significant bodily injury, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实受了严重的身体伤害。

sentences.en: So what did the agency do to ensure that that officer would not be unsafe in similar situations?
sentences.zh: 那么该机构采取了什么措施来确保该警官在类似情况下不会处于不安全状态？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, you're basically raising questions about whether ICE agents are sufficiently trained to handle these kinds of encounters.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你基本上是在质疑ICE特工是否受过足够的培训来处理这类遭遇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And whether or not—
sentences.zh: 而且是否——

sentences.en: Do you think they are?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们受过吗？

sentences.en: I don't have specific information about that.
sentences.zh: 我没有关于此的具体信息。

sentences.en: I just know what I've read.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我读到的内容。

sentences.en: I know what's been reported.
sentences.zh: 我知道报道的内容。

sentences.en: It's been reported that they're not even getting the level of training that they used to get, that the time of training is less.
sentences.zh: 据报道，他们甚至没有得到他们过去所能得到的培训水平，培训时间也减少了。

sentences.en: I think that's concerning.
sentences.zh: 我认为这令人担忧。

sentences.en: And I do think they are being forced into situations in which they are not well-prepared to deal with.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为他们正被迫陷入他们没有准备好应对的情况中。

sentences.en: Let me turn to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 让我转到调查问题上。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you about two issues that have arisen with this investigation.
sentences.zh: 我想问你关于这次调查中出现的两个问题。

sentences.en: The first, of course, is that the federal government has blocked local officials from participating in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 第一个当然是联邦政府阻止了地方官员参与调查。

sentences.en: And they basically argue that because of comments made by your boss, Mayor Jacob Fry, that local officials can't be objective.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上辩称，由于你的老板，市长Jacob Fry所发表的评论，地方官员无法做到客观。

sentences.en: On the other hand, you've got the Trump administration out there basically saying, you know,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，特朗普政府基本上在外面说，你知道，

sentences.en: Renee Goode is entirely at fault and the ICE officer did nothing wrong here.
sentences.zh: Renee Goode完全有过错，而ICE警官在这里没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: So can they be objective?
sentences.zh: 那么他们能客观吗？

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: how are you making sense of what has become an incredibly messy and contentious situation over what I normally think of as everybody doing joint investigations of a tragic situation?
sentences.zh: 你如何理解这一局面？它已经变成了一个极其混乱和充满争议的情况，而我通常认为大家会联合调查这种悲剧性事件。

sentences.en: Well, I think the loss here is the loss of any trust that the investigation would be legitimate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为损失的是对调查合法性的任何信任。

sentences.en: And I tell you, I know a lot of the FBI agents here, I believe the FBI will still do a thorough investigation because that's what they do.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，我认识这里的很多FBI探员，我相信FBI仍然会进行彻底的调查，因为这就是他们的工作。

sentences.en: That's what the people who staff this agency here, that's what they do every day.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里该机构工作人员每天所做的事情。

sentences.en: But will Minneapolis residents believe that it's a serious investigation?
sentences.zh: 但明尼阿波利斯的居民会相信这是一次严肃的调查吗？

sentences.en: But that's the problem.
sentences.zh: 但这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: The way this has played out has taken all sense of legitimacy away from many people.
sentences.zh: 事情的发展方式已经让许多人失去了对合法性的任何感知。

sentences.en: And that's very unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人遗憾。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what happens next now in this city as this investigation, for which there may not be much faith locally, unfolds.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈接下来在这个城市会发生什么，因为这项在当地可能没多少信任度的调查正在展开。

sentences.en: Because in the wake of this shooting and these protests, your governor has dispatched the National Guard to Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 因为在这次枪击事件和抗议活动之后，你们的州长已经向明尼阿波利斯派遣了国民警卫队。

sentences.en: The president is dispatching or plans to dispatch far more federal officials, Border Patrol agents.
sentences.zh: 总统正在派遣或计划派遣更多的联邦官员，即边境巡逻队特工。

sentences.en: Is that just going to magnify all the challenges that we have been talking about here?
sentences.zh: 这只会放大我们一直在讨论的所有挑战吗？

sentences.en: Well, I had asked the mayor to have the National Guard on standby as this was initially unfolding because it was so unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我曾要求市长让国民警卫队待命，因为这件事最初展开时太不可预测了。

sentences.en: I was afraid that once it came to the point where we might need the National Guard, it would probably take too long to get them here.
sentences.zh: 我担心一旦到了我们可能需要国民警卫队的时候，让他们赶到这里可能需要太长时间。

sentences.en: So that's why I'm glad they were on standby.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我很高兴他们当时处于待命状态的原因。

sentences.en: Going forward, it's my understanding that there is additional federal law enforcement being added to the state specifically to conduct more of these operations.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，据我了解，有额外的联邦执法人员被增派到该州，专门用于执行更多此类行动。

sentences.en: That is concerning.
sentences.zh: 这令人担忧。

sentences.en: If this escalates, are you worried, Chief O'Hara,
sentences.zh: 如果事态升级，奥哈拉局长，您是否担心

sentences.en: that all of this is just going to erase the work you've done over the past four-plus years to rebuild and repair the community's trust in the Minneapolis Police Department?
sentences.zh: 这一切会抹杀您过去四年多来为重建和修复社区对明尼阿波利斯警察局的信任所做的工作？

sentences.en: The number one priority that I worry about in terms of erasing work that we've done is ultimately erasing the gains that we've made, rebuilding the department,
sentences.zh: 我最担心的是，在抹杀我们所做的工作方面，最终会抹杀我们取得的成果、重建部门的努力，

sentences.en: and being able to reduce crime.
sentences.zh: 以及减少犯罪的能力。

sentences.en: You know, in June of 2020, immediately after the destruction of the city, the burning of a police station here, in that one month,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在2020年6月，就在这座城市遭到破坏、这里的一个警察局被烧毁之后，在那一个月里，

sentences.en: we had about as many shootings in one month as the city used to have in half a year.
sentences.zh: 我们一个月的枪击案数量几乎相当于这座城市过去半年的总量。

sentences.en: And that level of crime stayed very high.
sentences.zh: 而且这种犯罪水平一直居高不下。

sentences.en: And, you know, now the last couple of years has started to come down.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在过去几年里，犯罪率开始下降了。

sentences.en: And it's come down despite not having enough officers.
sentences.zh: 而且尽管警力不足，犯罪率还是下降了。

sentences.en: And we finally have started to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 我们终于开始重建了。

sentences.en: And I'm just afraid if we have another large-scale unrest that we are both going to have a dramatic increase in crime, yet again, that's predictable,
sentences.zh: 我只是担心，如果再发生大规模骚乱，我们不仅会再次面临犯罪率的急剧上升，这是可以预见的，

sentences.en: as well as another mass exodus of the department.
sentences.zh: 还会导致警局人员再次大规模流失。

sentences.en: And we just—we cannot sustain that.
sentences.zh: 我们真的——我们无法承受这些。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: is there any part of you that feels that this moment could strengthen the relationship between the community and police and test this work and reveal that you all have made progress,
sentences.zh: 您是否觉得这一时刻可能会加强社区与警察之间的关系，考验这些工作，并证明你们确实取得了进展，

sentences.en: that people will see a distinction between the MPD and the feds?
sentences.zh: 人们会看出明尼阿波利斯警察局（MPD）与联邦机构之间的区别？

sentences.en: I know that is true.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是事实。

sentences.en: I've had many people reach out and activists reach out, our elected officials.
sentences.zh: 很多人和活动人士，还有我们的民选官员都联系过我。

sentences.en: Many people who typically have nothing good to say about the Minneapolis police have been incredibly complimentary of how well, how restrained,
sentences.zh: 许多通常对明尼阿波利斯警察没什么好话的人，对明尼阿波利斯警察在过去几天这些非常、非常紧张的情况下，

sentences.en: how disciplined the Minneapolis police officers have been in these very, very tense situations over the last several days.
sentences.zh: 表现得如此出色、克制和纪律严明，给予了极高的评价。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But it's not universal.
sentences.zh: 但这并非普遍现象。

sentences.en: You know, there's people here who, despite what's happening, seem to think it's our job to do ICE's job.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里有些人，尽管发生了这些事，似乎还是认为做移民及海关执法局（ICE）的工作是我们的职责。

sentences.en: There's people here who seem to think that we should continue to make the same failed mistakes of the past when dealing with protests and crowd control and not utilize the best practices to de-escalate and to keep everyone safe.
sentences.zh: 这里有些人似乎认为，在处理抗议和人群控制时，我们应该继续犯过去那些失败的错误，而不是利用最佳实践来缓和局势并确保每个人的安全。

sentences.en: Are we fully here that?
sentences.zh: 我们完全做到这一点了吗？

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然没有。

sentences.en: We're not—we haven't accomplished winning trust with all levels of the community.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有——我们还没有赢得社区各阶层的信任。

sentences.en: That was obvious this week with all the hate and vitriol that was directed towards our officers.
sentences.zh: 本周针对我们警员的所有仇恨和谩骂就证明了这一点。

sentences.en: But there's certainly been progress.
sentences.zh: 但肯定已经取得了进展。

sentences.en: Just to end this conversation, Chief O'Hara,
sentences.zh: 最后想问一下，奥哈拉局长，

sentences.en: how do you think you get back to a simpler time in your policing where you can be focused on the reforms that you brought to the city on repairing relations between police and the community?
sentences.zh: 您认为如何才能回归到一种更简单的警务状态，让您可以专注于您为这座城市带来的改革，修复警察与社区之间的关系？

sentences.en: And in your mind, does ICE, does Border Patrol, do all these federal agents need to leave the city for you to do that?
sentences.zh: 在您看来，为了实现这一点，ICE、边境巡逻队以及所有这些联邦特工是否需要离开这座城市？

sentences.en: I mean, I think everybody wants to get back to some sense of normalcy, and I think that does involve some level of returning to some basic things that we accepted as normal.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为每个人都想回归某种正常状态，我认为这确实涉及到回归到我们所接受的一些基本常态。

sentences.en: You know, that obviously isn't federal law enforcement stops enforcing federal law.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这显然不是说联邦执法部门停止执行联邦法律。

sentences.en: Well, that's not the answer either, but it does have to do with having an honest conversation about reality.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那也不是答案，但这确实与就现实进行诚实的对话有关。

sentences.en: We've had many instances of people being stopped, family members of police officers being stopped that are American citizens.
sentences.zh: 我们已经发生过多次人们被拦截的事件，警察的家人被拦截，而他们是美国公民。

sentences.en: By ICE.
sentences.zh: 被ICE拦截。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's definitely—at best, it is definitely questionable.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对——往好了说，这绝对是有问题的。

sentences.en: They're not stopping family members of folks who are Norwegian or Irish.
sentences.zh: 他们不会去拦截挪威裔或爱尔兰裔民众的家人。

sentences.en: That's not happening.
sentences.zh: 那种事不会发生。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Just to return to that question, can your work at its best coexist with the work of an organization like ICE?
sentences.zh: 回到那个问题，您的工作在最好的情况下，能与像ICE这样的组织的工作共存吗？

sentences.en: We are doing it right now, and we are proving to the world that this is possible, that this is not the same police department it was five years ago or 10 years ago or 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就在这样做，我们正在向世界证明这是可能的，现在的警察局已经不是五年前、十年前或十五年前的那个警察局了。

sentences.en: But it is an unbelievable stress on everyone involved, and I think everybody needs to turn the heat down and hopefully get some sense of normalcy, some basic things to return.
sentences.zh: 但这给所有相关人员带来了难以置信的压力，我认为每个人都需要降降温，希望恢复某种正常感，让一些基本的事情回归。

sentences.en: Chief O'Hara, thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 奥哈拉局长，非常感谢您抽出时间。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: As massive anti-government protests spread across Iran over the weekend, Iran's president vowed to address the country's economic problems,
sentences.zh: 随着周末大规模反政府抗议活动在伊朗蔓延，伊朗总统誓言要解决该国的经济问题，

sentences.en: but showed no signs of backing off a harsh crackdown on demonstrators.
sentences.zh: 但没有表现出要停止对示威者进行严厉镇压的迹象。

sentences.en: That crackdown, activists say, may have killed as many as 200 people over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 活动人士称，这种镇压在过去几天里可能已经导致多达200人死亡。

sentences.en: So Iran's in big trouble.
sentences.zh: 所以伊朗陷入了大麻烦。

sentences.en: It looks to me that the people are taking over certain cities that nobody thought were really possible just a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，人们正在接管某些几周前没人认为有可能被接管的城市。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Trump administration is warning Iran's leaders that it could strike Iran if the regime continues to kill peaceful protesters.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特朗普政府警告伊朗领导人，如果该政权继续杀害和平抗议者，美国可能会打击伊朗。

sentences.en: The Times reports that U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，美国

sentences.en: military leaders have begun to brief President Trump on options for such strikes.
sentences.zh: 军事领导人已开始向特朗普总统简报此类打击行动的方案。

sentences.en: If they start killing people like they have in the past, we will get involved.
sentences.zh: 如果他们像过去那样开始杀人，我们就会介入。

sentences.en: We'll be hitting them very hard where it hurts.
sentences.zh: 我们将会在他们痛处给予沉重打击。

sentences.en: And that doesn't mean boots on the ground, but it means hitting them very, very hard where it hurts.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着派遣地面部队，但意味着在他们痛处给予非常、非常沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration is escalating its long-running feud with the chairman of the Federal Reserve, Jerome Powell, by opening a criminal investigation into his conduct.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府正在通过对美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔的行为展开刑事调查，来升级他们之间长期的不和。

sentences.en: The investigation centers around whether Powell lied to Congress about the scope of a multi-billion-dollar renovation project of the Fed's headquarters.
sentences.zh: 调查的核心是鲍威尔是否就美联储总部一个数十亿美元翻新项目的规模向国会撒谎。

sentences.en: But Trump's original conflict with Powell stems from his unwillingness to significantly slash interest rates as President Trump had demanded,
sentences.zh: 但特朗普与鲍威尔最初的冲突源于他不愿意像特朗普总统要求的那样大幅削减利率，

sentences.en: a reality that Powell highlighted in a video released on Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔在周日晚上发布的一段视频中强调了这一事实。

sentences.en: The threat of criminal charges is a consequence of the Federal Reserve setting interest rates based on our best assessment of what will serve the public,
sentences.zh: 刑事指控的威胁是美联储基于我们对什么最符合公众利益的最佳评估来设定利率的后果，

sentences.en: rather than following the preferences of the president.
sentences.zh: 而不是遵循总统的偏好。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Lindsay Garrison, Olivia Natt, and Ricky Nowetsky.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼、琳赛·加里森、奥利维亚·纳特和瑞奇·诺韦茨基制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao.
sentences.zh: 由莱克西·迪奥编辑。

sentences.en: Contains research help from Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 包含苏珊·李的研究协助。

sentences.zh: 音乐由丹·鲍威尔、马里昂·洛萨诺和阿丽莎·拜图创作。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢米奇·史密斯和尼古拉斯·博格尔-伯罗斯。

sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
